audits.resolution_reason: Accepted strict-family/unknown-override repair addresses part of this finding. Its broader domain questions remain unadjudicated; preserve source-bound evidence and current notes.
audits.text:
## 7f181d3b0012

**Classification: Reproduced contract defect plus a bounded domain question.** Audited source SHA-256 `70eb2d7ac8dadba5519d165b4f9d81ecb42ca586a47c264b6dfa284a1f9e5073` without modifying it.

**Reproduced defect.** `generate()` silently accepts the unknown key `__override_contract_unknown_axis__`; with seed 23/sample 9 it returns the same grid as the call without the typo. The source-bound probe is `checks/audit/7f181d3b0012/contract-probe.json`, and the shared override gate independently reports the same failure in `checks/audit/7f181d3b0012/battery-run/checks/7f181d3b0012_after_override.log`. A misspelled experiment axis can therefore be reported as exercised while doing nothing.

**Domain question / teaching shortcut.** The advertised valid domain includes `ud_symmetric` and `single_row`, and `self_check` accepts them. For the legal 3×3 input in `checks/audit/7f181d3b0012/symmetric-input.json`, the canonical Racket output in `symmetric-racket.json` is exactly `vconcat(g, g)`, so plain vertical duplication is observationally identical to the intended `vconcat(g, flip-ud(g))`. This is not necessarily a defect in default production—the source says default draws are asymmetric—but no `strict_canonical_like`, witnesses, rivals, or `lesson_identifiable` contract exists to prove that assembled lessons exclude the shortcut. The semantic gate fails for that missing contract.

The full battery also reproduced a below-floor canonical envelope (14/60, 23.3%), weak/overbroad `self_check`, and exact active-authority text divergence, while rule smoke, distribution, diversity, grammar, and Racket lint passed. See `checks/audit/7f181d3b0012/battery-run/`. Its task tests are additionally nonportable and fail before behavioral execution because of a fixed parent-depth canonical path (`checks/audit/7f181d3b0012/task-tests/`).

Recommended task-local repair: reject unknown keys; separate lawful-but-ambiguous degenerates from the training grammar or declare an ordered schedule that always includes an asymmetric witness; add executable duplication/rotation rivals and a lesson hook; then synchronize active authority text. No audit fix was applied.
